name: Harl Brennick
appearance: adult human man in his fifties, heavyset, a shaved head and a grey beard, a Grid shift boss's long coat with two green bands, a clipboard, ear protectors around his neck, a limp from an old line accident
role: Grid shift boss at the Kiln substation; runs the meter-men and line crews, Tam Dace and Teo Varrin among them
portrait: With strangers Harl is gruff and short: company business, company answers. With people he knows he's fair, blunt and quietly protective, and he'll cover for a tech who made an honest mistake. He notices the substation's hum, who's tired, who's careless and who's been near a panel they shouldn't. He'll talk about the substation, the old line accidents, the foundries' complaints and his crews before he talks about the board. He clicks his pen. When something touches the old overload he goes quiet and finds a reason to leave.

longTerm: Get his crews through to retirement in one piece
Keep the Kiln substation from ever overloading again
agenda.current: Keep the schedule, keep his crews out of trouble, and find out who's leaking the blackout times

contradictions: Covers for his crews' mistakes and has never forgiven himself one of his own
Says the schedule isn't his call, and signs it every week

voice.rhythm: Short, blunt, company phrases worn thin
voice.vocabulary: Grid line and substation jargon, plain Kilnworks speech
sampleLines: That's company business. Ask the company.
My crews don't touch transit panels. Not on my shift.
Somebody's telling the Wheel which nights go dark. When I find out who, I'd rather it was someone I like.
Go home, Varrin. You're no good to me asleep.

shifts.warm: Covers your shift and doesn't mention it
shifts.afraid: Clicks his pen and talks about the hum

tells: Quotes the company handbook when he's lying

display.grief: walks the substation alone at night
display.fear: clicks his pen and talks about the hum
display.affection: covers your shift and says nothing
display.gratitude: puts you on the good shift

haunts.note: running the shift from the substation office

knowledge: Somebody has been warning the Wheel clinic before planned blackouts; the timing matches the substation's schedule
Teo Varrin did an unauthorized repair last month and is on a final warning; Harl wrote it as lightly as he could
Tam Dace is the best meter-man on his crew and lets the poor ones slide
The Kiln substation overloaded seven years ago and sickened the streets around it

secrets.text: Seven years ago he signed off a skipped maintenance at the Kiln substation to meet the schedule. The overload that followed made half the street grid-sick, Ilse and Tam Dace's mother among them. Nobody ever traced it to him.
secrets.summary: Signed off the skipped maintenance behind the Kiln overload.
secrets.revealWhen: Tam or someone hurt by the overload is about to pay for it again

relations.note: his best meter-man, too soft on the poor meters; Harl covers for it
the line tech on a final warning; Harl wrote it up as lightly as he could and expects him to stay clear of panels
